description: Update an existing tweet. Can change text, category, schedule, or media. Cannot edit already-posted tweets.

community_id.description: X Community ID to post to, or null to remove

scheduled_date.description: New schedule date (ISO 8601), or null to unschedule

share_with_followers.description: Share community post with followers too

text.description: New tweet text (max 280 chars for free X accounts, up to 25,000 for Premium+)

thread_media.description: Media URLs per thread tweet (array of arrays)

thread_tweets.description: Updated thread tweets (excluding the first tweet which is the main text)

name: opentweet_update_tweet
